# Credit Card Product Optimization & CLV-Based Targeting

::: {.hero-lead}
A fintech credit card campaign project combining factorial experimentation with CLV-aware offer selection.
:::

::: {.metrics-grid}
::: {.detail-card}
### Objective
Select the best offer mix across 12 variants for roughly 750K customers.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Methods
Factorial design, response modeling, CLV simulation, and profit comparison.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Outcome
Projected about $866K in profit, with roughly $835K attributed to optimized targeting.
:::
:::
:::

:::{.section-row}
<div class="section-label">Overview</div>

The project balanced experimentation depth with commercial practicality by evaluating how product features and customer value interact in campaign design.
